roadmap.title: Main story and relics
roadmap.description: Play the five story regions in order and deliver each relic to the Collector.

roadmap.title: Abilities
roadmap.description: Use each Collector ability once you own it.

roadmap.title: Hull, stats and loadout
roadmap.description: Upgrade the hull, stack stat equipment, and fill cargo and equipment slots.

roadmap.title: Research
roadmap.description: Collect Research Parts and finish all four research trees.

roadmap.title: Totals and collections
roadmap.description: Let the catch and sell counters fill while you finish docks, shrines and side quests.

roadmap.title: Rosters and endings
roadmap.description: Catch every fish and aberration, then choose your endings.

roadmap.title: The Pale Reach DLC
roadmap.description: Finish the Pale Reach story, side quests and catches.

roadmap.title: The Iron Rig DLC
roadmap.description: Finish the Iron Rig story, rig buildings and catches.

roadmap.title: Final unlock
roadmap.description: From the Depths unlocks once every other achievement is done.

achievements.summary: Catch 250 fish with fishing rods.

guide.context: Only fish caught with a rod count. Trawl net and crab pot catches are separate.

steps.text: Fish at spots with a rod until your catch total reaches 250. Small, quick-to-catch fish in @loc{The Marrows} make the count go fastest.

achievements.summary: Catch 150 fish in trawl nets.

steps.text: Equip a trawl net, then keep it deployed while you sail and fish.
Empty the net when it fills, and sell or store the fish, until you reach 150.

achievements.summary: Catch 100 crabs in crab pots.

steps.text: Drop crab pots in crab water, then let time pass (resting 3 to 6 hours works).
Lift the pots, sell the crabs, and repeat until you reach 100. @loc{Stellar Basin} and @loc{The Marrows} work well with good pots.

achievements.description: Sell a total of $2500 worth of fish.
achievements.summary: Sell $2500 worth of fish in total.

steps.text: Sell caught fish at a fish market or dock until your total sales reach $2500.

achievements.description: Sell a total of $1500 worth of trinkets.
achievements.summary: Sell $1500 worth of trinkets in total.

steps.text: Dredge up trinkets and store them at any dock.
Sell them at a trader (for example in @loc{Little Marrow}) until your trinket sales reach $1500. Trinkets sell quickly in @loc{Devil's Spine}.

achievements.summary: Discard 25 fish.

guide.context: Rot does not count.

steps.text: Throw fish away from your cargo instead of selling them until you have discarded 25.

achievements.description: Deplete a total of 25 fishing spots.
achievements.summary: Deplete 25 fishing spots.

guide.context: Emptied spots refill slowly, so move on to new spots.

steps.text: Fish each spot until it is empty. Spots with big fish, such as sharks, run out faster. Repeat until 25 spots are depleted.

achievements.description: Catch all known species of fish.
achievements.summary: Catch every base-game fish species.

guide.context: Each fish entry lists its rod type, time of day (day is 6:00 to 18:00) and area. An aberration you catch also counts as its normal species.

steps.text: Research rods, engines and nets so you can reach every fish type, starting with the Flexible Fishing Pole, Improved Outboard Engine and Twin Prop Engine.

Catch every species region by region: @loc{The Marrows} fish 1 to 12, @loc{Gale Cliffs} 13 to 23, @loc{Stellar Basin} 24 to 39, @loc{Twisted Strand} 40 to 47, @loc{Devil's Spine} 48 to 56, and open ocean 57 to 63.

Land four one-of-a-kind fish. In @loc{Gale Cliffs}, the Oarfish hides behind the waterfall. The Gulper Eel near the Research Station in @loc{Stellar Basin}, the Goliath Tigerfish in the blocked pond on the south of @loc{Twisted Strand}, and the Coelacanth in the blocked passage behind @loc{Devil's Spine}. You need Abyssal, Hadal and Mangrove rods.

achievements.sortReason: First relic of the main story.
achievements.summary: Deliver the Key to the Collector.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{The Marrows} until you get the Key.
Bring the Key to the @npc{Collector} on Blackstone Isle.

achievements.summary: Hand the Music Box to the Collector.

steps.text: Finish the main story in @loc{Gale Cliffs}: help the Hermit, then blast the debris to reach the Music Box.
Bring the Music Box to the @npc{Collector}.

achievements.summary: Hand the Ring to the Collector.

steps.text: Dredge up the Ring in @loc{Stellar Basin}. Finishing the main story with the @npc{Researcher} first makes this safer.
Bring the Ring to the @npc{Collector}.

achievements.summary: Hand the Necklace to the Collector.

steps.text: Finish the main story in @loc{Twisted Strand}; the @npc{Airman} gives you the Necklace.
Bring the Necklace to the @npc{Collector}.

achievements.summary: Hand the Pocket Watch to the Collector.

steps.text: Finish the main story in @loc{Devil's Spine}; the @npc{Fanatic} gives you the Pocket Watch.
Bring the Pocket Watch to the @npc{Collector}.

achievements.description: Find a use for the relics.
achievements.summary: Reach the ending where you follow the Collector and use all five relics.

guide.context: You can still earn the other ending later: hand over the last relic, fight the @npc{Collector} to take it back, then follow the Sated steps.

steps.text: Deliver all five relics to the @npc{Collector}.
Agree to everything the @npc{Collector} says and tell him you are ready to trigger the bad ending.

achievements.sortReason: Alternate ending after the relic quests.
achievements.summary: Reach the alternate ending by refusing to hand over the final relic.

steps.text: After the first four relics, talk to the @npc{Collector}. Ask about the book and demand it. Do not say you are ready.
Leave Blackstone Isle and find the @npc{Old Mayor}. He is on an island to the east-north-east and may appear at an abandoned campsite dock (for example at P10). Finish his dialogue.
Return to the @npc{Lighthouse Keeper} in @loc{Greater Marrow}, tell her what you learned, and sail to where the light shines.

achievements.summary: Upgrade your hull to tier 2.

steps.text: Visit the @npc{Shipwright}, supply the materials and money, and buy the tier 2 hull upgrade.

achievements.summary: Upgrade your hull to tier 3.

guide.context: Dredge the materials in advance and leave them in storage so the upgrade is quick.

steps.text: At the shipwright, supply the materials and money, and buy the tier 3 hull upgrade.

achievements.summary: Upgrade your hull to tier 4.

steps.text: At the shipwright, supply the materials and money, and buy the tier 4 hull upgrade.

achievements.sortReason: Fits cargo once fish are caught.
achievements.summary: Fill every cargo space on your boat.

steps.text: Load large fish first, then fill the gaps with smaller fish, crabs and trinkets. Rotting fish turn into one-space rot, which fills a gap.

achievements.description: Install equipment into every slot on your ship.
achievements.summary: Install equipment in every slot on your boat.

steps.text: Put a rod, net, light or other fitting in every slot. Rearrange items until all fit. It is easiest after the later hull upgrades.

achievements.summary: Catch every base-game aberration.

guide.context: Aberrations are numbered 68 to 85 in @loc{The Marrows}, 86 to 96 in @loc{Gale Cliffs}, 97 to 109 in @loc{Stellar Basin}, 110 to 115 in @loc{Twisted Strand}, 116 to 121 in @loc{Devil's Spine} and 122 to 128 in open ocean.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Atrophy} on fishing spots to raise the chance of aberrations, and work through one region at a time.
For the Aberrant Jellyfish, trawl a spot where it appears and keep spinning in circles while the net is out.

achievements.sortReason: Cheap once the foghorn is owned.
achievements.summary: Hear a foghorn echo.

guide.context: A giant angler disguised as a tugboat also answers the horn, but it can destroy your boat.

steps.text: Equip the foghorn and use it while sailing, ideally at night in fog around @loc{The Marrows}, until a horn answers.

achievements.description: Spot a fish of each category through your spyglass.
achievements.summary: Spot a fish from every fishing-spot category through the spyglass.

steps.text: Equip the spyglass and look at a spot of each type: Coastal, Shallow and Oceanic near @loc{The Marrows}, Abyssal and Hadal near @loc{Stellar Basin}, Mangrove in @loc{Twisted Strand} and Volcanic in @loc{Devil's Spine}.

achievements.description: Use Mixed Bait to attract 3 different species to a single spot.
achievements.sortReason: Mixed Bait is available after Twisted Strand.
achievements.summary: Use Mixed Bait to draw three different species to one fishing spot.

steps.text: After the @loc{Twisted Strand} story, bring fish to the @npc{Airman} to make Mixed Bait.
Use the bait at a spot until three species are attracted. Some tries need a second bait.

achievements.description: Keep your Haste burn meter above 50% for 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Hold the Haste heat gauge over half for ten seconds straight.

guide.context: Filling the meter damages the boat. If you are stuck, empty valuables from your cargo, repair your boat, then let the meter fill once.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Haste} and keep tapping it, easing off before the meter fills.

achievements.description: Travel a long distance using Manifest.
achievements.summary: Travel a long distance with Manifest.

guide.context: Manifest unlocks after the @loc{Gale Cliffs} Music Box.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Manifest} from far away, for example from the @npc{Travelling Merchant} in @loc{Stellar Basin}.

achievements.summary: Banish 10 threats.

steps.text: Raise your panic by sailing at night on the open sea or toward apparitions until things attack you.
Use @mechanic{Banish} whenever something attacks, until you have banished 10. Ships at night count; small fish in @loc{Devil's Spine} may not.

achievements.description: Use Atrophy on a fishing spot a long way away.
achievements.summary: Use Atrophy on a fishing spot that is far from you.

guide.context: Distance is counted from the Disturbed Water when you use it, not from the map centre. A nearby spot ruins the attempt, and the ability then needs to cool down.

steps.text: Sail to the edge of the map, where spots are few, and draw Disturbed Water with bait.
Move away, then approach in small steps pressing @mechanic{Atrophy} until it reaches a spot at the edge of its range.

achievements.description: Complete all side quests. One way or another.
achievements.sortReason: Many separate quests; failures still count.
achievements.summary: Complete or fail every side quest.

guide.context: A failed quest still counts. The quests no longer have timers.

steps.text: Finish the story-linked quests as you meet them in each region.

Do the optional ones: Fishmonger special orders, the builder at Steele Point, the Mayor's package, the Bronze Beltbuckle, the Castaway, the lost dog, the Courier's ship, the Stone Emblems, the unique fish, the Conger Eel for Ingfell, and the four Hooded Figures.

Take each Hooded Figure the fish it asks for: Blue wants Blue, Tiger and Snake Mackerel; Gold wants Red Snapper, Fangtooth and Blue Crab; Purple wants Tarpon, Horseshoe Crab and Barreleye; Red wants Cusk Eel, Sailfish and Frilled Shark.

achievements.description: Visit every dock in the game.
achievements.summary: Visit every dock in the game.

steps.text: Visit each dock shown on the map.

Also dock at four campsites that the map does not mark: O2 on the south side of @loc{Gale Cliffs}, J3 on the island that sits midway to @loc{Stellar Basin}, F15 at the top of @loc{Twisted Strand}, and P10 on the island next to @loc{Devil's Spine}.

achievements.description: Solve all the fish shrine puzzles.
achievements.summary: Solve all four fish shrine puzzles.

guide.context: The Ghost Shark is in @loc{Devil's Spine} near I14, or possibly near G5. The Bronze Whaler is caught by day and the Blacktip Reef Shark at night, both near @loc{The Marrows}.

steps.text: At the shrine behind Great Marrow (J9), offer five Cod.
At the shrine near P3 on the back of @loc{Gale Cliffs}, offer two Rock Crabs and one Decorator Crab.
At the shrine near H2 on an island by @loc{Stellar Basin}, offer one each of the four sharks: Hammerhead, Ghost, Bronze Whaler and Blacktip Reef.
At the shrine in @loc{Twisted Strand} (D13), offer any aberrant fish.

achievements.summary: Research every rod.

guide.context: Research Parts come from the Shipyard (reload your save to refresh its stock), research dredge spots, wrecks, the Travelling Merchant, dog tags given to the Airman, and most side quests.

steps.text: Gather Research Parts and unlock each rod in the research menu until none are left.

achievements.summary: Research every trawl net.

steps.text: Gather Research Parts and unlock each net in the research menu until none are left.

achievements.summary: Research every crab pot.

steps.text: Gather Research Parts and unlock each pot in the research menu until none are left.

achievements.summary: Research every engine.

steps.text: Gather Research Parts and unlock each engine in the research menu until none are left.

achievements.description: Have a combined fishing speed of 200%.
achievements.summary: Reach a combined fishing speed of 200%.

steps.text: Install several rods of the same type until the total fishing speed shows 200%.

achievements.description: Have a combined engine speed of 75kn.
achievements.summary: Reach a combined engine speed of 75 knots.

steps.text: Buy engine upgrades until the combined speed shows 75kn.

achievements.description: Have a combined light strength of 3000 lumens.
achievements.summary: Get your lights to 3000 lumens combined.

steps.text: Reach hull tier 4 to unlock the light bar, which gives 3000 lumens, and install it.

achievements.summary: Finish the introduction quest.

steps.text: Complete the opening quest, which has you meet the @npc{Fishmonger} and the @npc{Shipwright}.

achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement.

steps.text: Unlock all other achievements; this one pops last.

achievements.description: Catch all known species of fish in The Pale Reach.
achievements.summary: Catch every fish species in The Pale Reach.

steps.text: Fish across @loc{The Pale Reach} until the region's species are all caught. Include the Sleeping Shark, a legendary fish near the frozen behemoth.

achievements.description: Catch all aberrations in The Pale Reach.
achievements.summary: Catch every aberration in The Pale Reach.

guide.context: There are 12 aberrations to catch, and 3 of them come from the Icefish.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Atrophy} on fish schools for guaranteed aberrations, though they may be rotting or infected.
For trawl-only catches, combine the Radiant Trawl Net, the Sinew Spindle, the Tendon Rod and the Encrusted Talisman. Together they add 16% to the aberration chance.

achievements.summary: Feed the Narwhal.

steps.text: During the opening quest of @loc{The Pale Reach}, collect enough fish to fill 16 cargo slots and feed the @npc{Narwhal}.

achievements.description: Finish the main quest in The Pale Reach.
achievements.summary: Complete the Pale Reach story quest.

steps.text: Follow the story: shatter the four frozen popsicles, free the Frozen Crew and collect the Ice Axes, then dredge your reward.

achievements.description: Finish all side quests in The Pale Reach.
achievements.summary: Finish all four side quests in The Pale Reach.

steps.text: Complete the story-linked side quests.
Meet the White Hooded Figure on the region's outskirts and give them three aberrations: Craterous Seer, Fallen Stars and Fractalline Icefish. Rotten fish are fine.

achievements.summary: Equip the Icebreaker.

steps.text: Dredge up the three Icebreaker parts at the sparking dredge spots in @loc{The Pale Reach}.
Bring them to the @npc{Travelling Merchant}, who assembles it, and then equip it.

achievements.description: Have 5 ice blocks in your cargo.
achievements.summary: Carry five ice blocks in the hold at once.

steps.text: Look for golden shimmers on the northern part of the Ice Flow to find the Ice Machine.
Complete the @npc{Travelling Merchant}'s request for two free ice blocks, then buy three more at the Shipyard.

achievements.summary: Catch the Colossal Squid.

steps.text: Deploy a trawl net and cruise the edges of @loc{The Pale Reach}; keep going until a Colossal Squid turns up.

achievements.description: Catch all known species of fish in The Iron Rig.
achievements.summary: Catch every fish species in The Iron Rig.

guide.context: The exotic #230 is not required.

steps.text: Fish the oil spills around @loc{The Iron Rig}. If a fish is not at one spill, check the others.

achievements.description: Catch all aberrations in The Iron Rig (excluding exotics).
achievements.summary: Catch every non-exotic aberration in The Iron Rig.

guide.context: Exotic aberrations are not needed.

steps.text: Catch each Iron Rig aberration. Crab-pot ones (#148 Cystic Trilobite, #187 Wretched Nipper, #202 Erupting Scorpion) cannot be forced and need time.

achievements.description: Deliver the missing shipment to the rig.
achievements.summary: Bring the lost shipment to the rig.

steps.text: Dredge the Ironhaven crate from the wreck south-west of the rig, marked by a golden oil-rig stamp.
Deliver it to the @npc{Foreman} at the rig.

achievements.summary: Override the rig's defences.

steps.text: Advance the story and get the Override blueprint from the scientist; it costs a crate and a Dark Canister.
Use it to override the rig's defences.

achievements.description: Build all levels of all buildings on the rig.
achievements.summary: Build every level of every building on the rig.

steps.text: Equip the material trawl net early to earn the materials needed for Ironhaven crates, and dredge Ironhaven wrecks for more.
Build and upgrade every building to its top level.

achievements.summary: Equip the Siphon Trawler.

steps.text: Progress the story until the tier 2 Factory engineer sells the Siphon Trawler. Buy it and equip it.

achievements.description: Collect a total of 10 Dark Canisters.
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Dark Canisters with the Siphon Trawler.

guide.context: Only canisters from the Siphon Trawler count; ones you craft in the Factory do not. Trawl Guidance Chips speed it up, and you can spend canisters along the way.

steps.text: Equip the Siphon Trawler and clean up oil spills; enough oil forms one Dark Canister. Repeat until you have collected 10.

achievements.summary: Upgrade to the tier 5 hull.

steps.text: Advance the story to meet the Ironhaven Executive and unlock fleet services.
Buy the tier 5 hull for a few crates and about $2500.

achievements.summary: Catch any exotic aberration.

steps.text: Get Exotic Bait from the level 4 Factory.
Toss it in a region with an exotic, then use @mechanic{Atrophy} for a guaranteed aberration. You must already have discovered that fish.

achievements.summary: Upgrade all three basic abilities.

steps.text: Once the tier 1 Tech Lab is built, its engineer sells improved versions of your light, foghorn and spyglass. Buy all three.

achievements.description: Have 5 Dark Splashes in your inventory.
achievements.summary: Hold five Dark Splashes at the same time.

guide.context: Dark Splashes lower your sanity.

steps.text: In an oil spill, let oil bubbles burst nearby or oil creatures explode near the boat. Collect until you hold 5 Dark Splashes.

achievements.description: Evade that which stalks the disturbed sediment.
achievements.summary: Dodge the lunge of the Gleaming Goliath.

guide.context: You must be inside the spill when you dodge.

steps.text: Sail into an Ooze spill and push panic to full, for example by running over Ooze Tumors.
When the @enemy{Gleaming Goliath} appears, drive toward its mouth. When it lunges, dodge out of the way (@mechanic{Haste} helps) while still inside the spill.
